notes.title: Update 18
notes.content:
1. A new game mode has been added to the game, which can be selected at the start. Now, when creating a new game, two modes will be offered:
1) MM: The player's position is saved, very rare regeneration of locations (once every 10 hours of game time)
2) Diablo: The player's position is not saved: the next time you start the game, you will appear in the village. The location is saved while you are in it. Locations will be regenerate if you have not been there for more than 30 minutes of game time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/2e85b8a85742043419367865f8241246fb44cb3a.jpg[/img]


2. 3D models are added for loot (swords, axes, etc.). So now, for example, if there is no space in the inventory, the item will not disappear, but will drop as 3D loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/dcaedf77be4ddc373666043befd9041bdf88acd5.jpg[/img]

3. Bosses now throw loot on the ground after death, and do not send it directly to the player's inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/4e37fdc56e179ea461885f1d280d395208352d2b.jpg[/img]

4. Loot is added to the big rat, the spider queen and Crufilus .
5. A bug with barrels is fixed, now they are saved normally (previously after loading there was often “Empty” instead of a bonus)
6. Lord Deray was weakened - his speed was reduced (so that he, at least, does not fly through doors).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/bdb83d174e64124a274e29e4fe38e23410c00723.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Turn-based mode
notes.content:
1. Turn-based mode! A turn-based mode has been added to the game - the same as in the game Might & Magic 8. The mode is switched by the Enter key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/2508cc1ad121b1971566b01b65d564e1ec264833.jpg[/img]

2. A new location is added - "Flower Garden".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/00c2ab087405f68b99c0efdff9e319f85f911bae.jpg[/img]

3. An image of the hero class has been added to the inventory of each hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/cd5829f9b3afb3bffc874e6aba38836c4452328f.jpg[/img]

4. New multiple fire shots have been added to Magogs.
5. Enemy treants have received new abilities - healing, earthquake
6. Troglodyte movement speed increased
7. Slime received a new type of attack - spitting. And it is better not to step on the defeated slime - it will hurt.
8. Skeletons got a new ability: resurrection after 1 minute.
9. Evil flowers have received almost complete immunity to magic, but they have less health. They also received new abilitiy: healing. Mature flowers received splash damage.
10. Boss Ogre got 3 new abilities: hitting the ground (earthquake), hit with a stun (the whole team becomes and cannot move and attack for 5 seconds), treatment.
11. Demon Demonologist got the ability "Ring of Fireballs".
12. Ice Golem got new abilities: "Ice Prison", "Ice Shard"
13. Butcher received the abilities "vampirism" and "bleeding"
14. The lava golem has received a new ability "ignite" on impact.
15. Ice golem got a new attack with massive ice shards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/7cf5aafd63eba3905cba0f639ee341e0addf03e4.jpg[/img]

16. Ghosts got abilities: blink and fly through walls.
17. The ability of the knight "Multi-strike" and "Lightning strike" has been corrected.
18. The fire mage's ability "Absorption of fire" has been changed to "Barrel of gunpowder", the abilities "Ball of fire", "Apocalypse" have been adjusted.
19. The ice mage's abilities "Ice Stakes", "Ice Nova" have been adjusted. Frost Energy ability changed to Mana Shield, Frost Aura changed to Mana Aura.
20. All active abilities have been corrected for the Archer (various arrows).
21. Significantly reduced the chance of drops of rings and amulets. And their cost, on the contrary, is significantly increased.
22. Implemented parameters for the items "+1 to all skills", "thorns", "frost".

notes.title: Hell update
notes.content:
1. Parameter requirements for items have been added. So now the heroes will not be able to equip all items as easily as before. Some items, for example, will require a lot of strength, while others will require a lot of other parameters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/4003456cc2f841c2cb1fe96960005bced27596dd.jpg[/img]

2. Some items (especially unique items) have become available only to certain classes of heroes. Thus, now the style of play for different heroes will be even more different. For example, now only the archer can wield powerful bows (only the basic bow is available to other classes), only the knight can wear heavy armor, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/225a0a159ebdae2af00b6416a186767457721469.jpg[/img]

3. Individual sounds of attack, pain, death, delight have been added to all heroes
4. A lot of traps are added in different locations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/d13319df91663ada2933f17e584c762aa3e4666b.jpg[/img]

5. Another opportunity to get to the location "Hell" is added.
6. Inventory overflow bug is fixed.
7. Difficulty warnings have been added on some levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/c1ecc9a55979af50e5dc43c2c551bc5809b0011d.jpg[/img]

8. The skeleton lord is weakened (he began to heal himself much more slowly).
9. Free treatment is fixed.
10. There are significantly more mini-map markings in the starting village now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/2f1537a8f13ab18275261686d3729ede992f0399.jpg[/img]

11. One of the rooms of the Fire Temple is fixed (it was not displaying walls on the minimap)
12. Death animations for monsters are fixed. Now they do not stand rooted to the spot after death.
13. Stairs are fixed in the library.
14. Lava and portal are fixed In the location "Hell", and a couple of secrets are added.
15. Fixed a bug with the deletion of the game, when the barrels and chests in the new game in the locations were not restored.
16. Fixed a bug with incorrect calculation of bonuses of some items when moving through locations.
17. Magogs got splash damage and self-explosion upon death.

notes.title: Ice golem
notes.content:
Update!

New:
1. Added a new boss - Ice Golem

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/5ca7c7925e22dccd428182a6b10b868a1018601c.jpg[/img]

2. Added new achievements (achievements). Among them - a number of class achievements, achievable only by a certain class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/0c6b68279a95f3dfa80ef4117dbcd615c8ed36f1.jpg[/img]

3. Added displayed melee weapon swings (sword, ax, hammer, staff).
4. Added a new mechanic - doors that can be closed and blocked by a trigger (used in the location with the Ice Golem to lock the doors of the room until you defeat the Golem).
5. Added tips and additional texts in dialogues with characters in the village.
6. Added another Air Key to the Ice Temple.

Changes:
1. Recharge! The principle of "recharge" (cooldown) on the used abilities of the heroes is changed. Each ability now has its own independent cooldown. And a small overall cooldown (1 second) for using any ability. For example, the ability of the earth mage "Ent" has a rather long cooldown - 30 seconds. Previously, when summoning an ent, the earthmage was "out" for all 30 seconds and could not fight, cast other spells. Now, when summoning an ent, the earthmage will be “out” only for 1 second, and then he can perform other actions besides the Ent, for example, simply shoot from a bow, or cause an earthquake (to use the ent, you will still need to wait 30 seconds).
2. The time of displaying text in dialogs has been increased (some texts earlier could not be read in time).
3. Changed the position of the electric guard (skill at the air magician). Now he hangs a little in the air and shoots much more accurately at enemies.
4. The bed no longer heals graves. Either a doctor or a hero with the "resurrection" ability can heal the grave.
5. Changed location " Ice Temple. Level 3 ".

The following bugs have been fixed:
1. Fixed a bug with switching inventory at the merchant when choosing another hero.
2. Fixed a bug with the Gloria‘s quest
3. Fixed bug with mouse quest
4. Fixed a bug with a spider that did not give skin

Elmarion: the Lost Temple is entering the GDWC this week. Please support the game with your voice at https://thegdwc.com/

Also this week the game has a 25% discount!

notes.title: Update №3
notes.content:
New
1. Added a new location: "Library"
2. Added a new location: "Woman Temple"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/6cf0e3f88e02675458387996b79dfe3aef596880.png[/img]

3. Added new characters and quests

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/ef8dcd04eeb0e712e34748b577814bd22de9d28b.png[/img]

4. Added new branches to existing dialogs
5. Added new secrets to most locations.
6. Added notes from the diaries of other heroes who have already visited the Lost Temple.
7. Maximum protection. New parameters have been added to both the hero and monsters: maximum armor and maximum resistances to elements, which bypass the restrictions on the base maximum defense. Thus, now in the game there may well be creatures and objects that are completely immune to some kind of attack. Also, for this, the parameters of the basic maximum defense and resistances to the elements of the player and monsters have been changed: now the basic possible maximum is 75% (but with the help of the new parameters of maximum defense, it can be 100%). New parameters of maximum protection can be found on unique items.

Fix bugs
1. Very rare but critical bug of location loading freeze. Occurred when generating a unique item with a 1 in 500 probability. Fixed.
2. Holes in the void in the temple of ice. Sometimes in the temple of ice you could find passages leading to a black void. Now, I hope, such passages will not meet again.
3. Doors and barrels with a shot. Previously, when clicking on a door or a barrel, the active hero fired his spell unnecessarily, losing mana and time. Now there is no more such an extra shot.
4. Random quest items. Previously, there was a small chance of getting a quest item where it shouldn't be: in chests and at bosses. Now this shouldn't happen again.
5. Quest items after use are now removed from the inventory.

Improvements / Changes
1. Updated graphic content for locations: "Old Temple" and "Lost Temple. Ruins "(1st level of the Lost Temple).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/4a506cf6a86134d66c5343a7fd48dd941e3b508b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/2fb642eea8f327970af83bbbc59f41817734b416.png[/img]

2. Air vortices in the temple of air. Earlier, air vortices were more like a rope, which is also inconvenient to use. Now air vortices work as expected of them: they lift the player into the air automatically: you just need to stand in the center of such a vortex.
3. The following skills have been changed: Divine Intervention (now the recharge time is 30 seconds), Lightning Flash (more damage, but less range and more mana cost), Ent Mage (less damage)
4. Changed the parameters of health and resistances of the last boss.

notes.title: Update №2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/e05ea43a3b8dc830e5133613048ff81175354733.jpg[/img]

What's new?
1. New mechanic of quick use of bottles of health and mana. Icons of health and mana bottles and their total number have appeared on the command panel. With new hotkeys, you can quickly use these bottles. By default, Q is for quick healing, E is for quick mana replenishment.
2. New destructible objects (mainly walls and some large stones). Such objects usually lead to new secret places.
3. New mechanics of mana recovery from obelisks: next to obelisks (crystals), mana regeneration is significantly accelerated.
4. The barrel mechanic is now used not only in the starting location. A lot of barrels have been added to all locations (mostly in secret places).
5. A lot of new secrets were added.
6. Items can now be sold to the merchant by double-clicking (accelerating the sale).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/82138ef6d8f627db8a5ef3dbe32237a0f1be7840.jpg[/img]


Bugs have been fixed:
1. A critical bug with loading a location in the temple of earth and the temple of air - freezing when reloading (through a portal, teleport, and even through a door). It occurred when young predatory flowers or maggot (temple of the earth) or ghosts (temple of air) were generated in the location. Fixed.
2. Free items from chests. When reopening the chest, it was possible to get free copies of the items lying there earlier. Now there is no such freebie anymore.
3. Hanging strange textures in the spider cave. Before some of the walls in the cave, one could observe some strange multi-colored "stubs" of the temple walls. I hope that I found and removed all such "stubs".
4. Holes in textures in the location of the 3rd level of the Lost Temple and in the locations of the Ice Temple. Fixed some of these holes.
5. Ents and spider eggs. Ents (and other summoned ones) used to ignore egg spiders. Now they also consider such spiders to be enemies.
6. Jamming of Ents and other summoned. The Ents often could not get through some passages and got stuck. Or they were simply distracted by a battle with some spider egg and lagged behind the player. Now, if this happens, the ent will teleport to the player.
7. The spiders from the eggs of the spider queen did not see the player and therefore the queen was easy to shoot from afar. Now the battle with this boss has become a little more difficult, because now her spiders have become more "discerning".
8. Double jump fixed (started working only from the 3rd level, now it works from the first skill level).
9. In areas near obelisks, enemies used to get stuck and blunt. Now they run normally.
10. Fixed sliders for adjusting brightness and contrast

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/beeb611b2c7cb70485f06d05c6c40446cc58e2c0.jpg[/img]

Improvements / Changes
1. Added information about monsters, whether they are demons or undead
2. Skill "Green Ray" received huge damage, but now only affects demons
3. The prices for bottles have changed: now the price is tied to the player's level
4. Many mushrooms have been added to the boxes (in the cave) (from which you can brew potions)
5. The teleport room in the Earth temple is now without monsters
6. Balance: changed the parameters of health and resistances of most monsters
7. Balance: changed the coefficient of gaining experience points (now experience is gained faster)
8. Changed the parameters of the skills "Apocalypse", "Ring of Fire", "Wall of Fire", "Chain Lightning", "Flash of Lightning", "Ray of Light", "Liana".
9. In all locations, significantly more chests have been added (especially for the temple of earth, fire, cold, air, chaos).
10. Regeneration of health and mana is now tied to the maximum stock of intelligence of the hero.
11. In the FIre temple, the rooms where you had to dive into the lava have changed for the passage. Now the lava there rises and falls and you can go through these passages without damage to health.
12. For entries in the loading window, a scroll and a button for deleting a saved game have now appeared.
13. In case of death, 5% of experience is now taken away, instead of 10% as before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252903/2cdb586e85bb97cf0b2b7a00942abdcb91573cac.jpg[/img]

Thanks to the players for the feedback!

notes.title: Bug fixing, skills and pets
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed:
1. Falling out through textures. This sometimes happened when killing a small enemy (such as a rat) underfoot with a melee weapon. Now you shouldn't accidentally fall through the floor.
2. Stacking things in the inventory. Occurred when transferring items from the chest with the right mouse button to the portrait of the hero. The thing was transferred to the inventory incorrectly and then caused overlaps on other things and the inability to correctly load next location.
3. Some locations were not loaded. It was an indirect consequence of the previous error.
4. Enemies shot at the hero and his pets (ents, skeleton, golem, bear, etc) through the walls. Now enemies can't do that! )
5. Accumulation of parameters. With a long game, it was possible to notice that the heroes somehow have too many basic parameters: strength, body, intelligence, speed, luck. Now this is no longer there.
6. Inability to sometimes take a thing in the chest. It occurs when all heroes are inactive. Now the inactivity of heroes does not affect this.
7. Taking inaccessible skills. You could drag an inaccessible skill onto the command bar and use it. This has now been fixed.
8. Take things from the trader for free. You could take any item from the trader for free without buying it, just dragging it into your inventory. This has now been fixed.
9. Exclamation marks at the NPC. Earlier, after completing the quest, these signs still remained on the NPC. Now, if the NPC does not have important messages, the exclamation mark is removed.
10. Incorrect work of some skills. Many skills have been fixed that either did not work or worked incorrectly before: for example, double jump, sacrifice and some others.
11. Failure to save the names and portraits of the characters of the party. When loading a save game, the character names and portraits were reset to default. This now works correctly.
12. Final score. There were scoring errors. And the final window could not be closed: the game would freeze. It's all fixed now.
13. Invisible enemies. In some locations (especially in the Earth Templef), one could meet invisible enemies, which, of course, were difficult to fight with. Invisible enemies have been eliminated.
14. A hole in the wall in one of the rooms in the Earth Temple. Now this hole is gone.
15. In the tutorial location, an extra confusing audio track was removed in one of the prompting videos.
16. Some starting skills (such as feather, torch) could not be upgraded beyond the 1st level. Fixed.
17. Failure to preserve non-starting skills as active ones in heroes. Now all skills are well preserved in the active status.
18. Failure to receive an item from the boss if all the heroes in the team are unavailable (lost their turn). This has now been fixed.
19. Getting free of charge unique items from the boss killed once. This happened when exiting-entering from a location with a boss to another location and back. At the same time, the boss killed earlier gave a freebie one more unique one, and there was no need to kill him again.


Improvements
1. Skill tree. A signature was added for each skill: what is needed to get it (what level is needed and what other skill you need to have).
2. Automatic following you of your pets (ent, skeleton, golem, bear) was added.
3. Icons for improving skills. Tt was hard to tell if the ability worked or not without icons.
4. Quest tips. The text of many quests did not fit into the specified field and therefore it was not visible. Now all quest texts are normally visible.
5. Hints when loading. Previously, these prompts had small print and were difficult to read. Now the font has been increased for them and a black background has been added.
6. Improved balance: enemies (especially later ones) got more health and improved damage. And for heroes, the speed of gaining experience has been reduced. The level requirements for obtaining skills have also been increased. (For example, previously the Bear ability was attainable from level 40, but now only from level 60).
7. The elevators in the Air Temple have been adjusted. I hope that now you will not need to use the scroll of the portal to the city to save you.
8. Increased the delay time for replicas in dialogs to make it easier to read them.
9. Added a description of the parameters: strength, body, intelligence, speed, luck.
10. Passive skills. For passive skills, a separate signature has appeared that they are passive. Also, passive skills can no longer be transferred to the additional active skills panel.
11. The flag of the Russian language is placed on the start page without the need to click the English flag: now it is immediately visible.

Thanks to the players for the feedback!
